Class WindowsGraphicsCard

java.lang.Object
oshi.hardware.common.AbstractGraphicsCard
oshi.hardware.common.platform.windows.WindowsGraphicsCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
GraphicsCard
@ThreadSafe public abstract class WindowsGraphicsCard extends AbstractGraphicsCard
Common logic for a Windows GraphicsCard, including the WMI fallback enumeration used when the display device registry keys yield nothing.

Both bindings enumerate cards identically once their driver has returned the WMI rows; only which driver is called differs, so buildFromWmi(List, Map, WmiResult, Function, WindowsGraphicsCard.CardFactory) takes the query result and a factory rather than performing the query itself.

    • buildFromWmi

      protected static List<GraphicsCard> buildFromWmi(List<DxgiAdapterInfo> dxgiAdapters, Map<String,String> lhmParentMap, WmiResult<Win32VideoController.VideoControllerProperty> cards, Function<DxgiAdapterInfo, String> luidPrefixBuilder, WindowsGraphicsCard.CardFactory factory)
      Builds the card list from Win32_VideoController rows, used as a fallback when the display device registry keys yield nothing.

      The returned list is ordered to match DXGI enumeration order, which places the primary desktop adapter first, with any unmatched cards appended.

      Parameters:
      dxgiAdapters - all DXGI adapters, retained unmutated as the stable reference for ordering lookups
      lhmParentMap - normalized GPU name to LHM parent identifier
      cards - the Win32_VideoController query result
      luidPrefixBuilder - derives the PDH LUID prefix for a matched adapter, falling back to a PDH instance lookup
      factory - creates the backend's card type
      Returns:
      the cards, never null
